misses.why: House kit made in China, assembled in Italy, used, disassembled: the engine kept China; HQ held Italy, where the kit last became the house.
Retanning and dyeing U.S. wet blue hides in Brazil was read as a transformation to crust leather; HQ held the United States.
Sintered spinel from China, then crushed, milled and classified in Germany: engine kept China (crushing is not a transformation); CBP held Germany. Label is manual.
Helmet shell moulded in Taiwan, liner and assembly in China. Essential character is close; the engine flips between identical runs (right in -litellm-gw).
Pen with an Indian refill and Chinese barrel parts assembled in China: the engine named N345964 (refill gives character) and still chose China, at 0.65.

Pureeing and blending fruit, then pasteurising, was read as simple processing; CBP held France (a different food: puree). No fruit-puree precedent exists before this date, so retrieval is not the cause.
Oven lights with two scenarios; the label is the second scenario's result and the engine answered the first. The ruling has two answers.
Air filter: CBP held China, where the filter paper is made; the engine took Thailand, where it was pleated and assembled.
Jack stands: Thai ratchet bar, Chinese base parts, assembly in Thailand. Close; right in two other identical runs.
Door lock: Chinese knob assemblies, Vietnamese cylinder and latch. CBP held China; the engine held Vietnam. Retrieved precedents are ovens and ranges, not locks.
Cooking and canning razor clams was read as a transformation; CBP held the harvest country. The gateway run (-litellm-gw) was right: the call is close.
Esterification and distillation of crude fish oil was read as a chemical transformation; CBP held Peru (refining an oil). Label is manual.
Four retrieved sibling air filters all held China (Chinese media); here the media is composited and pleated in Thailand and CBP held Thailand. The near-duplicate precedents anchored the answer.
Soap: UK soap base, mixed and moulded in Canada. Close; right in one other identical run.
Borax pentahydrate (U.S.) made into decahydrate in France: the engine held that a hydration change is not a transformation; CBP held France (new chemical name and use).
Metal tiara body from China, Cambodian headband and combs, gluing, screwing and ribbon in Cambodia: engine kept China; CBP held Cambodia.
Showerhead: about 40 parts from China, assembled and tested in Thailand. The engine called it simple assembly; CBP held Thailand.

Cooking skewered chicken was read as a transformation (N345699, fully cooked, battered chicken: China); CBP held the United States, as for chargrilled chicken (N339749). Retrieved precedents point both ways.
Deodorising filter: Korean core and mesh, Chinese carbon, filled and heat-pressed in Korea. The five retrieved water filters all held Korea; right in one other identical run.
